metadata.standard: ICAR / USDA-ARS / UC-IPM Integrated Crop Protection Guidelines
metadata.safety_disclaimer: All treatments are prototype reference guidelines and require certified agronomist/farmer validation before tank mixing or field dispersion.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Water-soaked circular lesions turning brown on leaves and fruit, causing yellowing and premature leaf drop.

severity_levels.mild: Scattered small (<3mm) necrotic spots on lower canopy leaves.
severity_levels.moderate: Lesions expanding across 15-30% of foliage with localized yellowing.
severity_levels.severe: Widespread blight, partial defoliation, lesion formation on stems/pods.

treatments.application_method: Precision foliar misting targeting under-canopy and infected leaf clusters
treatments.safety_notes: Wear respirator, nitrile gloves, and eye protection. 48-hour re-entry interval.
treatments.notes: Fixed copper mixed with mancozeb improves efficacy against copper-tolerant Xanthomonas strains.

treatments.application_method: Preventative protective spray during high humidity periods
treatments.safety_notes: Biological formulation. Zero pre-harvest interval; safe for pollinators.
treatments.notes: Colonizes leaf surface to competitively exclude pathogenic bacteria.

Pepper__bell___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous green foliage with upright posture, uniform coloration, and absence of necrotic spotting.

severity_levels.none: Zero pathology detected. Plant exhibits optimal physiological vigor.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown, target-like spots with distinct concentric rings on older lower leaves.

severity_levels.mild: Few localized target-spot lesions restricted to basal foliage.
severity_levels.moderate: Concentric rings spreading up mid-canopy; chlorotic halo around spots.
severity_levels.severe: Leaf desiccation, early senescence, potential tuber infection via spore washdown.

treatments.application_method: Downward cone spray targeting lower canopy leaves before spore spread
treatments.safety_notes: Toxic to fish. 48-hour re-entry interval. Apply PPE (Category I/II safety).
treatments.notes: Standard multisite contact protectant; apply at first visual sign of concentric lesions.

treatments.application_method: Targeted misting with fine droplet spectrum
treatments.safety_notes: Rotate with non-Group 11 fungicides to prevent fungal resistance.
treatments.notes: Provides translaminar movement to inhibit fungal mitochondrial respiration.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green/brown lesions turning dark brown with white fungal down on lower surface in humid weather.

severity_levels.mild: Water-soaked spots at leaf tips and margins under high moisture.
severity_levels.moderate: Rapid lesion expansion, stem rot, white sporulation visible on underside.
severity_levels.severe: Complete collapse of plant canopy; tubers rot with firm dry brown necrosis.

treatments.application_method: Comprehensive leaf wetting coating both upper and lower leaf surfaces
treatments.safety_notes: Emergency intervention required immediately upon detection. PPE mandatory.
treatments.notes: Cymoxanil provides penetrant kickback activity within 48 hours of infection.

treatments.application_method: Targeted foliar application under overcast or high humidity conditions
treatments.notes: Inhibits sporangial germination and oomycete cell-wall formation.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Lush pinnate leaves without spotting, curling, or water soaking.

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small greasy/water-soaked spots that become angular and purplish-brown with yellow haloes.

severity_levels.mild: Scattered circular spots (<2mm) with yellow borders on lower leaves.
severity_levels.moderate: Spots coalescing, causing ragged tear holes and yellowing of leaflets.
severity_levels.severe: Defoliation exposing fruit to sunscald; scab-like raised lesions on fruit.

treatments.application_method: Precision foliar spray under calm wind (<10 km/h) conditions
treatments.safety_notes: Avoid spraying during peak midday heat to prevent chemical scorch.
treatments.notes: Synergistic copper-mancozeb combination neutralizes copper-resistant strains.

Tomato_Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric rings with target board pattern on older leaves, progressing upward.

severity_levels.mild: Basal leaf lesions (<5mm) with dark concentric ridges.
severity_levels.moderate: Chlorosis around lesions, spreading into mid-canopy foliage.
severity_levels.severe: Extensive defoliation exceeding 40% of canopy, collar rot on stems.

treatments.application_method: Precision misting directed at lower foliage clusters
treatments.safety_notes: Respirator and protective gloves required. 48-hour re-entry interval.
treatments.notes: Multisite fungal spore protectant proven against Alternaria.

treatments.application_method: Targeted evening misting on early symptomatic leaves
treatments.safety_notes: Organic certified. Safe for beneficial pollinators in evening applications.
treatments.notes: Contains limonoids that disrupt fungal germination and sporulation.

Tomato_Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular grayish-green lesions turning dark brown with white mold on lower surface.

severity_levels.mild: Water-soaked patches at leaf margins following moist/rainy periods.
severity_levels.moderate: Rapidly expanding lesions, brown petioles, white sporulation underneath.
severity_levels.severe: Canopy collapse, dark sunken lesions on green and ripening tomatoes.

treatments.application_method: Full-coverage downward and horizontal nozzle misting
treatments.safety_notes: Critical aggressive disease. Immediate quarantine and spray required.
treatments.notes: Curative translaminar activity arrests active mycelial growth.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green or yellow spots on the upper leaf surface; olive-green to brown velvety mold on lower surface.

severity_levels.mild: Chlorotic spots on upper side with faint velvety growth on lower side.
severity_levels.moderate: Velvety olive-brown fungal growth spreading across mid-canopy.
severity_levels.severe: Leaves curl, wither, and drop prematurely, severely reducing yield.

treatments.application_method: Spray directed at underside of lower and middle leaves
treatments.notes: Reduces spore germination in relative humidity above 85%.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular lesions with gray/tan centers and dark brown margins, with tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia).

severity_levels.mild: Scattered circular spots (<3mm) confined to oldest bottom leaves.
severity_levels.moderate: Multiple coalescing lesions causing leaflet chlorosis and leaf curl.
severity_levels.severe: Upward canopy defoliation exposing fruit to sunscald.

treatments.application_method: Downward precision spray coating infected basal foliage
treatments.safety_notes: Do not exceed 4 applications per season to protect soil biome.
treatments.notes: Directly halts Septoria pycnidiospore germination on leaf surface.

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.symptoms: Yellow or white stippling (speckling) on leaf surface, fine silken webbing on undersides, bronzing.

severity_levels.mild: Fine yellow stippling visible on upper leaf surfaces of a few leaves.
severity_levels.moderate: Dense speckling, fine webbing visible under leaves and at petiole nodes.
severity_levels.severe: Extensive webbing covering leaf clusters, bronzing, leaf desiccation.

treatments.application_method: High-pressure fine misting targeted directly under leaf canopies
treatments.safety_notes: Apply during early morning or evening to prevent phototoxic scorching.
treatments.notes: Suffocates spider mite nymphs and disrupts adult reproductive egg-laying.
Highly effective against mite juvenile stages and mite egg hatching.

Tomato__Target_Spot.symptoms: Small brown circular lesions with light brown centers and dark brown margins, resembling a target.

severity_levels.mild: Pinpoint brown specks on upper canopy foliage.
severity_levels.moderate: Target lesions expanding to 5-10mm with distinct concentric zones.
severity_levels.severe: Leaf drop and sunken circular lesions on mature green/red fruit.

treatments.application_method: Uniform canopy spray with fine mist cone nozzle
treatments.safety_notes: Rotate with multi-site contact fungicides to manage resistance.
treatments.notes: Excellent translaminar protection against Corynespora target spot.

Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe upward leaf curling, cup-shaped leaflets, interveinal chlorosis, stunted bushy plant growth.

severity_levels.mild: Subtle upward cupping of youngest apical leaves with slight pale margin.
severity_levels.moderate: Pronounced leaf curling, reduced leaflet size, noticeable plant stunting.
severity_levels.severe: Severe bushy dwarfism, complete flower abscission, zero fruit set.

treatments.application_method: Foliar spray targeting whitefly nymphs on leaf undersides
treatments.safety_notes: Viruses cannot be cured chemically; primary intervention is vector control.
treatments.notes: Reduces whitefly vector populations to prevent secondary plant-to-plant transmission.

treatments.application_method: Manually remove severely infected plants in sealed plastic bags
treatments.safety_notes: Burn or deeply bury infected residues away from the field perimeter.
treatments.notes: Essential to eliminate primary virus reservoirs in the crop rows.

Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Light and dark green mottling (mosaic pattern) on leaves, leaf distortion (shoestring or fern-like look).

severity_levels.mild: Faint mosaic pattern on upper leaflets with slight leaf crinkling.
severity_levels.moderate: Obvious mottling, reduced leaf blade area, slight fruit internal browning.
severity_levels.severe: Severe 'fern-leaf' distortion, systemic stunting, unmarketable fruit.

treatments.treatment: Disinfectant Tool Wash (20% Non-Fat Dry Milk or 10% TSP)
treatments.application_method: Dip robotic pruning arms and tools between plants
treatments.safety_notes: Mechanical transmission is extremely rapid via contact and equipment.
treatments.notes: Milk proteins inactivate the stable viral capsid protein coat on contact.

Tomato_healthy.symptoms: Lush compound leaves, vibrant green foliage, vigorous apical shoot growth.

severity_levels.none: Healthy tomato foliage. Zero chemical intervention required.
